links.outcome: Concordance of LLM carpal tunnel syndrome recommendations with AAOS clinical practice guidelines
links.effect: Across 252 recommendations, 72.6% concordant, 11.5% discordant, 15.9% indeterminate; ChatGPT 92.1% concordant (1.6% discordant), Mistral 52.4% concordant (17.5% discordant).
links.quote: Over 1 in 4 LLM-generated CTS recommendations were not concordant with AAOS CPGs.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM concordance with AAOS clinical practice guidelines for carpal tunnel syndrome using standardized prompts, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
